target_customer: Product and engineering teams at startups and tech companies that use Slack for team communication
problem: Group chat tools like Slack become a catch all, so urgent messages get lost; Patchwork replaced chat with a ranked personal feed and added chat for urgent needs.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat (pricing not published)

founders.name: Nikki Shah
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page (engineer, engineering manager and product lead).

founders.name: Dhruhin Kurli
founders.role: Founder (listed under former founders on YC)
prior_employers: Meta (tech lead on new AR line)
education: UC San Diego, computer science (finished in 2.5 years)

competitors.name: Slack
competitors.what: Dominant team chat incumbent that Patchwork positions itself as replacing

competitors.name: Glue
competitors.what: Thread based Slack and Teams alternative backed by David Sacks

technical_complexity.rationale: A feed ranking and chat app using LLMs for post assistance is mainstream product engineering; ranking relevance is the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Chat tools have strong network effects favoring Slack and Microsoft Teams, and a feed layer can be copied or added by incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source on an incumbent response to Patchwork; Slack added AI features generally after 2024.

market_need_then: The Launch HN post of 2024-03-27 argues chat mixes all communication types and hides urgent messages, a common complaint about Slack; no usage metrics were disclosed.

branding.domain_note: Used atpatchwork.com because the exact Patchwork name was taken; email contacts use that domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Founder voice contrasting feeds with chat

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN thread on 2024-03-27; no merch or community found

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with an SSB messaging app, an open source project and other products, no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Patchwork joined YC in Winter 2024 with two big tech veterans building a feed based Slack replacement and reportedly raised the standard $500K. YC lists it inactive and Dhruhin Kurli under former founders, and the site returned an error, but no source states why, so the cause is not public. The generic name and strong incumbents are context only.
notes: Funding: StartupIntros lists a $500K seed dated 2024-04-01 and FundedIQ a $500K pre seed in Apr 2024; label conflicts so stage is other, single database basis. VCBacked reports $24.4M and a Series B from 2022 for a different Patchwork; ignored. YC launch post names founders as Nikki Shah and Dhruhin. Glue source is dated May 2024, a few months after the W24 batch. atpatchwork.com returned HTTP 503. Exit unknown.
